intervals.label: collaboration active
intervals.note: Month precision for the start, from the collaboration member's page. Dore (EPJ H 37, 2012) writes 'took data from 1977 in the neutrino beam of the CERN SPS' and the CERN Courier says the first SPS neutrino beams appeared early in 1977; the page's December 1976 is kept as the experiment's own statement. In 1983 the detector was split in two parts for a neutrino-oscillation experiment in the PS neutrino beam (Dore).
intervals.quote: The experiment took data in the CERN neutrino beams from December 1976 until 1984.

intervals.label: collaboration completed
intervals.note: Terminal event: end of data taking, year precision ('until 1984').

name: CDHS Collaboration
notes: No source dates the formation of the collaboration. Leadership is not recorded as a row because no person record exists for Jack Steinberger on this branch.

summary.plain: The group of CERN, Dortmund, Heidelberg and Saclay physicists, later joined by Warsaw and led by Jack Steinberger, that built and ran the CDHS neutrino experiment.
summary.technical: CERN-Dortmund-Heidelberg-Saclay collaboration (Warsaw joined later), led by Jack Steinberger; 35 publications.
